regression_incident.description: first run of audit_website.py and audit_coverage_gaps.py showed a doubled page count (3506 vs 1753) and 52 false-positive orphan_indexable_page findings
regression_incident.root_cause: .cloudflare-dist (the Phase 17 deployed bundle, deliberately kept on disk after deployment) was being scanned as duplicate site content by two audit scripts that have no build-output directory exclusion rule - same class of issue first found in Phase 11
regression_incident.fix: deleted the disposable, gitignored, fully-reproducible .cloudflare-dist artifact; re-ran both scripts fresh, confirmed 0 findings and correct page count
regression_incident.classification: audit-hygiene oversight from Phase 17/18, not a code or production defect
